blocks.eyebrow: Why full ingredient lists are rare
blocks.heading: “Proprietary extract” is a lawful way of saying nothing
quotes: “Five appealing names on the box, then one long phrase in English.”
“I react to one specific ingredient, and almost no brand lists enough for me to check.”
“Two products, a threefold price difference, near-identical ingredient panels.”
“I want to compare, and there is nothing to compare with.”

explainer.heading: The order in an INCI list says more than the list itself
body: INCI lists run in descending order of proportion. An active sitting 38th out of 45 is in the formula — and its position already tells you roughly at what level.
Which is why many panels name only “key ingredients”: list everything and the reader can see the order, and order is hard to dress up.
This jar declares all 45 ingredients in INCI order. We are not claiming that makes the formula better — only that you have enough to judge it yourself, including against other brands.

blocks.footnote: More ingredients does not mean more suitable. For settled skin it is a choice; for reacting skin, fewer variables is what you need.
blocks.transition: Once you know which jar suits your phase, below are the twelve ingredients worth naming out of the full list.

blocks.heading: Three things worth knowing first, including one that may stop you buying
blocks.intro: A few parts of this formula are easy to misread. Better said up front.

items.heading: It contains Titanium Dioxide and Zinc Oxide — but it is NOT a sunscreen
items.body: Both are physical filters, but the pack declares no SPF or PA rating. With no rating there is no basis for using it in place of sunscreen. Keep applying a separate one.

items.heading: Sensitive skin, or a known ingredient allergy
items.body: This is where a full panel earns its keep: you can look up the exact substance you reacted to, instead of guessing behind a trade name.

items.heading: You just want a simple moisturiser
items.body: Forty-five ingredients is a lot for skin to meet. If yours is settled and only needs hydration, a shorter formula is the more sensible choice.

blocks.intro: INCI order reflects descending proportion. That is why niacinamide's position matters more than the fact that it is present at all.

rows.name: Nymphaea alba flower extract

rows.name: Xylitylglucoside, anhydroxylitol, xylitol

rows.name: Lactobacillus ferment
rows.role: Fermented ingredient, related to the skin surface microbiome.

rows.name: Helichrysum italicum extract
rows.role: Immortelle extract, used among calming ingredients.

rows.name: Dipotassium glycyrrhizate

rows.name: Sea water
rows.role: Seawater, a mineral source in the formula.

rows.name: Physalis angulata extract

items.q: Does the titanium dioxide and zinc oxide make it a sunscreen?
items.a: No. Those minerals act as physical filters at high concentration in a formula designed and tested for an SPF figure. Here they sit near the end of the INCI list in small amounts. You still need a separate sunscreen in the morning.

items.q: Why is this the only product with a full INCI list?
items.a: It is what we would like to see for every product. At present the manufacturer publishes the complete list only for this one; for the others this site prints exactly what is on the packaging and does not fill in the rest.
Keep away from heat and direct sunlight, close after use, keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with the eyes.
